/en/lp/audit/.q: Can the report be submitted to a bank?

/en/lp/audit/.q: What information is needed for a quote?

/en/services/accounting-monterrey/.q: Can you coordinate with our internal team?
/en/services/accounting-monterrey/.a: The proposal can establish a division of responsibilities with your team. Before work starts, the engagement identifies who prepares information, who reviews it and who authorizes the relevant actions.
Included obligations and tax returns must be expressly identified in the proposal. The scope depends on your business activities, tax position and requirements.

/en/services/accounting-monterrey/.q: Which documents do we need to begin?
/en/services/accounting-monterrey/.a: Your needs are reviewed first. Relevant information is then requested, which may include accounting records, reports and tax documents. Please do not send confidential documents through the initial contact form.

/servicios/asesoria-fiscal-monterrey/.q: ¿Puedo consultar una operación antes de realizarla?
/servicios/asesoria-fiscal-monterrey/.a: Sí puede plantear la operación que está considerando. Revisarla con anticipación permite identificar información faltante y aspectos fiscales que conviene entender antes de decidir.

/servicios/asesoria-fiscal-monterrey/.q: ¿Es lo mismo que llevar la contabilidad?
/servicios/asesoria-fiscal-monterrey/.a: No. La contabilidad registra y organiza información recurrente. La asesoría fiscal analiza preguntas o decisiones concretas. Ambos servicios pueden complementarse cuando la necesidad lo requiere.

/servicios/asesoria-fiscal-monterrey/.q: ¿Qué sucede si recibimos una comunicación de la autoridad?
/servicios/asesoria-fiscal-monterrey/.a: Indique el tipo de documento y la fecha de recepción al solicitar contacto, sin adjuntar datos sensibles. La firma deberá evaluar el asunto y confirmar si puede atenderlo, con qué alcance y en qué tiempos.

/servicios/asesoria-fiscal-monterrey/.q: ¿La consulta incluye una opinión por escrito?
/servicios/asesoria-fiscal-monterrey/.a: El formato y alcance de los entregables deben acordarse en la propuesta. Una conversación inicial no sustituye un análisis documentado ni implica una conclusión profesional sobre su caso.

/en/services/tax-advisory-monterrey/.q: Does tax advisory guarantee lower taxes?
/en/services/tax-advisory-monterrey/.a: No. Advisory work evaluates obligations, alternatives and risks within the law. Outcomes depend on your business facts and the applicable rules. No specific tax saving is promised.

/en/services/tax-advisory-monterrey/.q: Can we discuss a transaction before carrying it out?
/en/services/tax-advisory-monterrey/.a: You can bring a proposed transaction to the consultation. An early review helps identify missing information and tax considerations that should be understood before a decision is made.

/en/services/tax-advisory-monterrey/.q: Is this the same as accounting?
/en/services/tax-advisory-monterrey/.a: No. Accounting records and organizes recurring information. Tax advisory examines specific questions or decisions. The two services can complement each other where the engagement requires it.

/en/services/tax-advisory-monterrey/.q: What if we receive a notice from a tax authority?
/en/services/tax-advisory-monterrey/.a: State the document type and date received when requesting contact, without attaching sensitive data. The firm must assess the matter and confirm whether it can assist, under what scope and within which timeframe.

/en/services/tax-advisory-monterrey/.q: Will we receive a written opinion?
/en/services/tax-advisory-monterrey/.a: Deliverable formats and scope should be agreed in the proposal. An initial conversation does not replace a documented assessment or constitute a professional conclusion about your case.

/servicios/auditoria-monterrey/.a: No necesariamente. La naturaleza y extensión de los procedimientos dependen del tipo de encargo y las normas aplicables. El alcance debe quedar claro antes de iniciar el trabajo.

/servicios/auditoria-monterrey/.q: ¿Pueden auditar una empresa cuya contabilidad lleva otro despacho?
/servicios/auditoria-monterrey/.a: Puede solicitar la evaluación del encargo. La firma deberá revisar las condiciones de independencia, la disponibilidad de información y la coordinación necesaria con los responsables de los registros.

/servicios/auditoria-monterrey/.q: ¿El informe sirve para un banco o un inversionista?
/servicios/auditoria-monterrey/.a: Depende de los requisitos del destinatario. Comparta esos requisitos antes de contratar para confirmar el tipo de informe requerido y si la firma puede atender ese encargo.
No. Toda revisión tiene objetivos, alcance y limitaciones. No debe presentarse como garantía absoluta de ausencia de errores o irregularidades, ni como promesa de una opinión favorable.
Una descripción de la necesidad, el periodo de interés y los requerimientos del destinatario. Después se define la documentación financiera y de soporte que corresponde solicitar.

/en/services/audit-monterrey/.q: Does an audit examine every transaction?
/en/services/audit-monterrey/.a: Not necessarily. The nature and extent of procedures depend on the engagement type and applicable standards. The scope must be clearly understood before work begins.

/en/services/audit-monterrey/.q: Can you audit a company whose accounting is handled by another firm?
/en/services/audit-monterrey/.a: You can request an engagement assessment. The firm must consider independence requirements, information availability and the coordination needed with those responsible for the records.

/en/services/audit-monterrey/.q: Can the report be used by a bank or investor?
/en/services/audit-monterrey/.a: That depends on the recipient’s requirements. Share those requirements before commissioning the work so the required report type and the firm’s ability to undertake it can be confirmed.

/en/services/audit-monterrey/.q: Does an audit guarantee that every irregularity will be detected?
/en/services/audit-monterrey/.a: No. Every review has objectives, a scope and limitations. It should not be presented as an absolute guarantee that errors or irregularities are absent, or as a promise of a favorable opinion.

/en/services/audit-monterrey/.q: What does our business need to get started?
/en/services/audit-monterrey/.a: A description of the requirement, the period concerned and the recipient’s conditions. The appropriate financial information and supporting documentation can then be specified.

/servicios/consultoria-negocios-monterre.a: No es indispensable para solicitar contacto. Describa qué decisión enfrenta o qué situación le preocupa. La conversación inicial sirve para delimitar la necesidad y valorar un posible proyecto.
Solo si se acuerda expresamente. Una propuesta debe distinguir entre análisis, recomendaciones y acompañamiento de implementación, con responsables y entregables para cada parte contratada.
La información disponible se revisa al definir el alcance. Si faltan datos relevantes, se identifican las limitaciones y lo que conviene obtener antes de formular conclusiones.
Depende de la pregunta, la disponibilidad de información y las personas involucradas. El calendario se define en la propuesta; no se ofrece un plazo estándar sin conocer el caso.

/en/services/business-consulting-monterr.q: Does the problem need to be fully defined before we contact you?
/en/services/business-consulting-monterr.a: No. Describe the decision you face or the situation that concerns you. The initial conversation helps clarify the need and assess whether an engagement would be appropriate.
Only where expressly agreed. A proposal should distinguish analysis, recommendations and implementation support, with responsibilities and deliverables for each contracted component.

/en/services/business-consulting-monterr.q: Can you work with our existing information?
/en/services/business-consulting-monterr.a: Available information is reviewed when the scope is defined. Where relevant data is missing, the limitations and information needed before drawing conclusions should be identified.

/en/services/business-consulting-monterr.q: How long does a project take?
/en/services/business-consulting-monterr.a: This depends on the question, information availability and the people involved. A schedule is defined in the proposal. No standard turnaround is offered without understanding the specific circumstances.

No. The service provides information and analysis to support decisions. Results depend on execution, market conditions and other business factors that should be considered when evaluating recommendations.

/servicios/servicios-administrativos-mon.a: Puede solicitar una propuesta para una necesidad concreta. La viabilidad y el alcance dependen del volumen, los controles requeridos y la forma en que la actividad se integra con su empresa.
Las facultades y autorizaciones deben quedar documentadas antes de iniciar. El apoyo administrativo no debe interpretarse como una autorización general para disponer de recursos de su empresa.
La propuesta debe definir tareas y responsabilidades específicas. No implica por sí misma suministro de personal ni una modalidad laboral determinada; esas condiciones requieren revisión expresa.

No automáticamente. La operación administrativa y el registro contable tienen alcances distintos. Si necesita ambos, revise [Contabilidad y Cumplimiento Fiscal](/servicios/contabilidad-monterrey/) para definir una propuesta coordinada.

/servicios/servicios-administrativos-mon.q: ¿Cómo se maneja la información de la empresa?
/servicios/servicios-administrativos-mon.a: Antes de compartir información se deben acordar accesos, responsabilidades y medios adecuados. Solicite las condiciones de tratamiento de datos y confidencialidad aplicables al servicio que desea contratar.

/en/services/administrative-services-mon.q: Can we engage you for just one activity?
/en/services/administrative-services-mon.a: You can request a proposal for a specific need. Feasibility and scope depend on activity volume, required controls and how the work connects with your business operations.
Authority and approvals should be documented before the service begins. Administrative assistance should not be treated as unrestricted permission to use your company’s funds or resources.

/en/services/administrative-services-mon.q: Does the service replace our employees?
/en/services/administrative-services-mon.a: The proposal must define specific activities and responsibilities. The service does not automatically constitute personnel supply or a particular employment arrangement. Those conditions require explicit review.

Not automatically. Administrative operations and accounting records have different scopes. If you need both, explore [Accounting and Tax Compliance](/en/services/accounting-monterrey/) to establish a coordinated proposal.

Before sharing information, appropriate access rights, responsibilities and communication methods should be agreed. Request the data handling and confidentiality terms that apply to the service you are considering.
